resources.string: On — off. EasyList and AdGuard filters, custom lists and a site whitelist

The blocker intercepts page network requests and hides ad elements using EasyList / AdGuard filters — like lightweight browsers do. Userscripts (Tampermonkey-style) run IN PARALLEL and independently: the blocker cuts ads at the network level, scripts add their own features on top. They never conflict. If a site breaks, whitelist it or switch blocking off.
Several lists can be enabled — rules auto-refresh every 3 days
Every browser download shows up here: pause and resume, cancel, retry after errors and queue priority. Tap a finished download to open the file.
Videos and streams found on the page
The video sniffer is off — enable the toggle below to detect videos and HLS streams on pages
Nothing found yet. Open a page with a video and wait a couple of seconds — direct links and streams appear here

Userscripts are tiny Tampermonkey-style extensions: they restyle sites, add buttons, clean up interfaces. They run in parallel with the ad blocker and never conflict with it. Add your own .user.js via file or link.
Articles saved from reader mode live here. Open an article → Menu → “Reader mode” → “Save” — it appears here in clean typography, available offline.
Open any article, enable reader mode (Menu → “Reader mode”) and tap “Save” — the article stays here even offline.
Full page snapshots for reading without internet. On any page: Menu → “Save offline”.
All downloaded files and the link journal. The full manager with pause, resume and priorities — Files → Downloads.
